bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 4.5” x 6.5” and smaller than 14”x14”x6” are allowed with X-Ray screening. Small clutches and purses under 4.5”x6.5” are permitted without X-Ray but are subject to inspection.
allowed: Bags larger than 4.5” x 6.5” and smaller than 14”x14”x6”
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions for medical and parental bags smaller than 14” x 14” x 6” are allowed with X-Ray screening.

parking.note: Parking at Xfinity Mobile Arena can be reserved in advance through SpotHero for up to 50% off drive-up rates. Accessible parking is available near entrances, and daily subway parking is offered in Lot A on weekdays.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Wells Fargo Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Wells Fargo Center offers a wide variety of food and drink options, including popular chains like Shake Shack and Chickie's & Pete's, as well as local favorites such as Federal Donuts and 9th Street Italian Sandwiches. Special offerings include gluten-free options and kosher meals, ensuring there's something for everyone.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The Kidology Sensory Room, located on the Suite Level, is open to any fan that needs sensory relief.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Wells Fargo Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Wells Fargo Center. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Wells Fargo Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
